description: CSS animation-fill-mode forwards and both on virtual time (CSS slice 3a): forwards after the end, kept through a hover and a class toggle that restyle the element; both with a delay (first keyframe before the start, last after the end); an even alternate iteration count with forwards; a fill mode through var(); an inline fill mode the app changes to none after the end and back; a static inline both (Svelte: the whole shorthand in the style attribute; React and Vue: the fill mode in a style object, as Chromium serializes a shorthand written through CSSOM differently, docs/gaps/PLATFORM.md); display: none and shown again (a new animation); an animation-name change (a new animation, filled with its own last keyframe)
